text: At Starliner Towers, a luxury apartment block outside Montreal, a doctor kills a young woman and himself, leaving behind [a parasite bred to take over a human organ|origin|monsters people made] and meant to turn the world into [one beautiful mindless orgy|wants|lust and indulgence]. Nick Tudor talks to the creatures moving in his abdomen, and soon [a kiss passes them on|rules|it passes to others] from apartment to apartment. As hallways fill with residents assaulting one another, the resident doctor Roger St. Luc searches for a way out, until [Janine and Betts smile at him from the swimming pool|images|water and drowning].
